GLOBAL.NS.d: Global Education Limited provides educational and consultancy services in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Educational Training and Development Activities; and Educational Business Support Activities. The company provides professional training and skill development to corporates, teachers, and students, as well as other various business support services to education institutions, corporates, and banks.

GRAPHITE.NS.d: Graphite India Limited manufactures and sells graphite electrodes, and carbon and graphite specialty products in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Graphite and Carbon, and Others. The company offers a range of graphite electrodes with various diameter and power for AC and DC furnaces.

GRMOVER.NS.d: GRM Overseas Limited grows, processes and distributes branded and generic basmati rice around the world. It also sells spices and whole wheat flour under its Shakti brand, and exports to markets including the Middle East, the United Kingdom and other European countries.

INDOUS.NS.d: Indo Us Bio-Tech Ltd. is an Indian company covering the whole seed value chain: production, processing, packaging and distribution. Its seeds include many vegetables such as cowpea, beetroot, peppers, radish, cabbage, cucumber, carrot, brinjal, bottle gourd, okra and tomato.

INFY.NS.d: Infosys Limited, through its global subsidiaries, delivers an extensive range of consulting, technology, outsourcing, and cutting-edge digital solutions across North America, Europe, India, and other international markets. Its diverse service portfolio includes the development and ongoing management of applications, impartial validation, product engineering and lifecycle oversight, infrastructure administration, comprehensive enterprise application management, and critical support and integration capabilities.

INNOVISION.NS.d: Innovision Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker INNOVISION and traded in INR. Its country is India.

IPL.NS.d: India Pesticides Limited, incorporated in 1984 and based in Lucknow, is an agrochemical company that makes, sells and distributes insecticides, fungicides, herbicides and other agrochemicals, and also active pharmaceutical ingredients. It exports to about 35 countries.

ITL.NS.d: ITL Industries Limited is an Indian company engaged in manufacturing and exporting chemicals. They produce various chemicals, including specialty chemicals and bulk drugs. The company is headquartered in India.

JASH.NS.d: Jash Engineering Limited manufactures, trades in, and sells various engineering products for general engineering, water and waste water, power plant, and bulk solids handling industries in India.

JINDALSAW.NS.d: Jindal Saw Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and supplies iron and steel pipes and pellets in India and internationally. It operates through Iron and Steel, Waterways Logistics, and Others segments.

JMA.NS.d: Jullundur Motor Agency (Delhi) Limited trades and distributes automobile parts, accessories, and petroleum products primarily in India. The company offers automotive components; fly wheel rings; gaskets and radiators; thin wall engine bearings, bushings, and thrust washers; hydraulic brake parts, fluids, and coolants; fan belts; suspension, drive shafts, and filters; automotive air springs; engine oil and grease; window balancers; water pump assy products; rear axles shafts; and air, oil, and fuel filters.

KABRAEXTRU.NS.d: Kabra Extrusiontechnik Limited manufactures and sells plastic extrusion machinery and allied equipment in India. The company offers pipe extrusion lines, such as twin screw PVC pipe extrusion lines; PE pipe extrusion lines; control and automation systems; and downstream equipment, including vacuum calibrators, water spray baths, pipe haul-off units, pipe cut-off units, and tripping chutes for use in drinking water transportation, irrigation, building construction, infrastructure development, and gas transportation…

KAJARIACER.NS.d: Kajaria Ceramics Limited manufactures and sells ceramic and vitrified tiles under the Kajaria Eternity brand in India. The company's products include ceramic wall and floor tiles, polished vitrified tiles, glazed vitrified tiles, sanitary ware and faucets, adhesives for ceramic and vitrified tiles, epoxy and unsanded grout, and tiles cleaner. It also exports its products to approximately 35 countries. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

KOPRAN.NS.d: Kopran Limited, an integrated pharmaceutical company, manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients and finished dosage forms in India and internationally.

KRISHIVAL.NS.d: Krishival Foods Limited processes, trades and sells dry fruits and nuts, including cashews, almonds, figs, peanuts, raisins and pistachios, and also sells online. Incorporated in 2014 and headquartered in Mumbai, it was formerly Empyrean Cashews Limited and took its present name in May 2023.

LIBERTSHOE.NS.d: Liberty Shoes Limited manufactures and trades in footwear, accessories, and lifestyle products in India and internationally. The company offers footwear products, such as casual, formal, sports, fashion, women, kids, and men footwear under the AHA, Coolers, Footfun, Force 10, Fortune, Gliders, Healers, Leap7X, Perfect, and Senorita brands. It operates through 100 distributors and 425 exclusive showrooms, as well as online. Liberty Shoes Limited was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Karnal, India.

LLOYDSENT.NS.d: Lloyds Enterprises Ltd. and its affiliates mainly trade iron and steel in India. Its divisions are Real Estate, Steel, Engineering and Electrical, and it is also involved in real estate, including developing residential and commercial properties.

MAHSEAMLES.NS.d: Maharashtra Seamless Limited manufactures and sells seamless steel pipes and tubes in India. It operates in three segments: Steel Pipes & Tubes, Power – Electricity, and RIG. The company offers mild steel and galvanized pipes, API line pipes, oil country tubular goods (OCTG) pipes, and casing and tubing products; and hot finished pipes and tubes, cold drawn and boiler tubes, and OCTG drill pipes.

NGLFINE.NS.d: NGL Fine-Chem Limited, headquartered in Mumbai and established in 1981, produces and distributes pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates for veterinary and human health worldwide. Its animal-health active ingredients include diminazene aceturate, homidium chloride, nitroxynil and clorsulon.

NIACL.NS.d: The New India Assurance Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a general insurance company in India and internationally. The company provides marine cargo and hull, motor, health, travel, home and contents, customized business and SME products, other personal, industrial, rural, machinery, aviation, liability, fire and burglary, crop, personal accident, and property insurance products. It also offers reinsurance products. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

ORIENTCEM.NS.d: Orient Cement Limited manufactures and sells cement in India. The company offers pozzolana and ordinary Portland cement under the Birla.A1 brand name. Its products are used in residential, commercial, infrastructure, industrial, and community projects. Orient Cement Limited was founded in 1979 and is based in New Delhi, India.

PRIMESECU.NS.d: Prime Securities Limited provides corporate advisory and investment banking services in India. It offers corporate advisory services that include financial advisory for debt and capital structuring; strategic, business, and value enhancement; mergers and acquisitions, and stake sales; and structured debt placement/loan syndications.

PUNJLLOYD.NS.d: Punj Lloyd Limited provides integrated design, engineering, procurement, construction, and project management services for energy and infrastructure sectors in India and internationally.

RAJPALAYAM.NS.d: Rajapalayam Mills Limited is a textile manufacturer based in Rajapalayam, India, producing a wide range of cotton yarns and fabrics. Their products cater to both domestic and international markets, with a focus on quality and innovation. The company aims to be a leading player in the textile industry through continuous improvement and sustainable practices.

REFEX.NS.d: Refex Industries Limited engages in handling and disposal of fly ash from power plants in India. It operates through Coal & Ash Handling Business, Solar Power-Generation and Related Activities, Refrigerant Gases-Manufacturing (Refilling), and Sale of Service segments. The company primarily refills hydrofluorocarbons, which are used in automobile and room air-conditioners, and refrigerating equipment.

REMUS.NS.d: Remus Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the marketing, trading, and distribution of finished dosage formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in India and internationally. The company's diverse product portfolio, exceeding 600 offerings, includes tablets, capsules, injections, creams, gels, eye drops, and various other dosage forms.

RICOAUTO.NS.d: Rico Auto Industries Limited, an engineering company, manufactures and supplies high precision fully machined aluminum, and ferrous components and assemblies to automotive original equipment manufacturers worldwide. Its integrated services include the design, development, tooling, casting, machining, assembly, and research and development of aluminum and ferrous products.

RKFORGE.NS.d: Ramkrishna Forgings Limited manufactures and supplies open and closed die forgings of carbon and alloy steel, micro alloy steel, and stainless steel in India and internationally.

RPSGVENT.NS.d: CESC Ventures Limited owns, operates, invests, and promotes business in the fields of information technology, business process outsourcing, real estate, entertainment, and fast moving consumer goods in India.

SADBHIN.NS.d: Sadbhav Infrastructure Project Limited engages in the development, construction, operation, and maintenance of infrastructure projects in India. The company develops highways and roads on a build, operate, and transfer basis. It also provides related consulting and advisory services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Ahmedabad, India. Sadbhav Infrastructure Project Limited is a subsidiary of Sadbhav Engineering Limited.

SAKUMA.NS.d: Sakuma Exports Limited engages in the trading of agro commodities in India. The company act as a buyer, processor, marketer, exporter, and importer of agricultural commodities, such as sugar and by-products; sesame seeds, groundnut kernels, sunflower seeds, safflower seeds, etc.; rice, wheat, corn, barley, millet, and sorghum; pulses and beans; coriander seeds, cumin seeds, turmeric, kalonji, fenugreek seeds, fennel, ajwain, nutmeg, mustard, cardamom, black pepper, dill seeds, ginger, various grounded spices, and…

SBFC.NS.d: SBFC Finance Limited is a financial services provider offering secured credit to micro, small and medium enterprises and loans against gold. It also provides loan portfolio management to third-party institutions such as banks, mutual funds and asset reconstruction companies. Established in 2008 and headquartered in Mumbai, it is a subsidiary of SBFC Holdings Pte. Ltd.

SPANDANA.NS.d: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited engages in the micro finance business in India. The company offers income generation loans for low-income households; loans against property; and loans for women to expand their existing income generating activities, smoothening household cash flows, and acquiring productive assets. It also provides gold loans for agriculture, business, and short-term liquidity needs; and interim loans. The company serves low-income clients in urban and rural areas.

STEL.NS.d: STEL Holdings Limited engages in the investment activities in India. The company was formerly known as Sentinel Tea and Exports Limited and changed its name to STEL Holdings Limited in July 2011. STEL Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Kochi, India.

SUPERHOUSE.NS.d: Superhouse Limited is engaged in the manufacture of leather footwear, finished leather, leather shoe uppers, other leather products, and textile products in India, operating manufacturing units and exporting to over 50 countries.

SVPGLOB.NS.d: SVP Global Textiles Limited, founded in 1898 and headquartered in Mumbai, makes and distributes textile goods, mainly cotton yarns, and exports internationally. It also trades in fabrics, precious stones, diamonds and gold.

TPLPLASTEH.NS.d: TPL Plastech Limited functions as a holding company, primarily involved in the production of diverse plastic and polymer goods. Its main offices are situated in Mumbai, Maharashtra, and all its business activities are centered exclusively within India, focusing on the polymer products sector. The company's offerings include a range of narrow-mouth drums with capacities of 210, 235, and 250 liters.

TRENT.NS.d: Trent Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates a chain of retail stores primarily under the Westside brand in India. The company's Westside stores provide women's wear, men's wear, kids' wear, footwear, lingerie, cosmetics, perfumes, accessories, and home furniture products.

VISL.NS.d: Vedanta Iron and Steel Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker VISL and traded in INR. It is classified in the Materials sector (Metals & Mining). Its country is India.

WELSPUNLIV.NS.d: Welspun Living Limited, founded in 1985 and headquartered in Mumbai, makes and sells household textiles worldwide. Its range covers towels and bathrobes in several weave styles, bath rugs and mats made from cotton, nylon, PET and polyester filaments, and bedding items such as pillow inserts and mattress protectors.

WINDMACHIN.NS.d: Windsor Machines Limited engages in the manufacturing and selling of plastic processing machinery in India and internationally. The company operates through Extrusion Machinery and Injection Moulding Machinery segments. It offers injection molding machines, including two platen, toggle, hydro-mechanical, and electric injection molding machines.

ZFCVINDIA.NS.d: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Limited (ZFCVCSIL) designs, develops, produces and distributes automotive solutions from its base in India. For commercial vehicles it supplies active and passive safety systems and steering and clutch mechanisms, among other components.
